# Frozen pre-4.0 saves

Produced once on 8 November 2026 with unmodified origin/main at 0f428c2fef43a821bbea782823f7548b5d514971, before any implementation. These files are immutable; RECEIPT.json pins their bytes and hashes. PRODUCER.ts.txt records the producer, which ran from tests/frozen-producer.test.ts. Do not regenerate these with newer engines.

Synthetic local saves from the 3.0.0 (28) game source, not extracted family data or a claim that this default-mode source tree is the signed preview build. Includes Family plus four named learners; all 28 School games at Level 4, all six classics, five boards and five activities per owner. Persistent Arcade engine constructors are recorded separately. Existing profile-2.5.json and profile-3.0.json remain earlier frozen inputs.

The near-limit file contains valid legacy learning notes, not whitespace padding. Its migration may safely refuse admission; preserving accepted bytes is required.
